title: Luna placement reliability v2: five states, three fresh trials each
description: Frozen control-cost-aware complete transfer selection; Luna/high with the same tools, two native cameras, 600 controls and no inherited experience. Includes exact blocked GraspGen preprocessing, discoverable previously selected object IDs, and measured release-completion reporting.
scope: Fifteen fresh Luna episodes on five additional bowl initialization states. Each policy starts clean; no cross-episode memory, demonstrations or recorded coordinates. Physical reset seed stays 0; model sampling seed is not controlled. Same-source model repetitions, not fifteen different geometries. All completed attempts are reported; no success-selected retries.
